UI_LXWP_desc: Each local character (split-screen included) gets a starter pack once, worn on the back. Pick what goes in it.
UI_LXWP_enable_tip: Off = the mod does nothing. Characters who already got their package keep it.
UI_LXWP_backpack_tip: Off = the gear goes straight into the main inventory, with no backpack.
UI_LXWP_weapons_tip: Off = no weapons or ammo in the package.
UI_LXWP_tools_tip: Off = no building or breaching tools in the package.
UI_LXWP_survival_tip: Off = no water or medical supplies in the package.
